predictor.raw_BF16_artifact_encoding: uint16 bit patterns, native little endian

probe.first_scene_timing_scope: BF16 input conversion + predictor forward + fixed mask/plan + first measured merge/MLP/split/LS2/residual; excludes cold loads, warmups, hash/metrics/file I/O

limitations: Checkpoint size/SHA and source RGB/calibration admission are bound to the pinned board receipts; this audit does not independently read the 5 GB checkpoint or decode source images.
LayerNorm, FC1, GELU, FC2 and predictor are not re-executed on the host. Saved LayerScale multiplication and residual addition are independently checked.
Hooked full forward timing includes capture hooks; it is not an unhooked speed comparison or an approximation quality result.

results.host_execution: NumPy saved-array arithmetic only; no Torch, real model, predictor, camera or image decoder invoked
results.speed_scope: one isolated MLP branch; predictor overhead separately reported

MLP_only_arithmetic_projection.scope: Arithmetic projection for this 48-group scene, not latency; no attention or head savings; added predictor and merge/split overhead are excluded
